name: three-d-meshy-image
title: 3D from a photo: a GLB with Meshy 7.1
description: Loads your photo of one object, sends it to Meshy 7.1 through Comfy's partner node Meshy: Image to Model, and saves the textured model it returns as a GLB file. Meshy runs on its maker's service and bills your Comfy account through your Comfy key.
